Taxes and fees at San Miguel de Allende hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 20% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 20% at Cuna del Cielo to 23% at NIDO Hotel. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
